name: oppo-bac-ninh-20-10
description: Video chúc mừng 20/10 cho OPPO Bắc Ninh — Remotion 2K

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.render: npm run media:stage && remotion render src/index.ts OppoBacNinh2010 out/oppo-bac-ninh-20-10-final-polished-1440p60.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=17 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=320k
scripts.prerender: npm run media:prepare && npm run check && npm run preview:final
scripts.render:fast: npm run media:prepare && npm run check && npm run preview:final && python3 scripts/final/render.py all
